title: Text-based item difficulty estimation, IRT calibration and learner performance prediction on a Kazakh–Russian gamified learning platform: code
description: Code accompanying the article 'Text-Based Item Difficulty Estimation, IRT Calibration and Learner Performance Prediction on a Kazakh–Russian Gamified Learning Platform' (IJACSA). Part 1 predicts item difficulty from text (TF-IDF, sentence embeddings, fine-tuned mBERT / XLM-RoBERTa / KazRoBERTa). Part 2 calibrates tournament items with 1PL/2PL/3PL IRT, validates text-based predictions on new tournament items and tests text-based priors in a calibration simulation. Part 3 compares Elo, Glicko-2, TrueSkill and machine-learning models of learner proficiency. Data source: Aqyl Battle, a Kazakh-Russian quiz learning game. Raw data (question texts, learner-level records) are not redistributed; reported result tables and figures are included.
